sections.title: 1. Introduction & Module Overview
sections.intro:
Maintenance module hotel ki assets (AC, geyser, lights, lift, generator) aur unke repairs ka system hai. Guest rooms, public areas aur kitchen ke maintenance requests track hote hain.

MAINTENANCE FLOW: Assets register (Location + Asset Master) → Complaint/request aayi (room me ya HK/FO se) → Technician assign → Repair complete → Asset history. Preventive maintenance schedule bhi track hota hai.

subsections.title: Key Benefits
bullets: Room maintenance ka HK/FO integration — OOO/blocked rooms track
Service requests QR portal se bhi aati hain (guest portal)

subsections.title: 2.1 Location Master
subsections.paragraph: Property ke maintenance locations — Guest Rooms (floor wise), Lobby, Restaurant, Kitchen, Pool, Generator Room, Lifts etc. Complaint aur assets isi location pe tag hote hain.

rows: Location in use hai ya nahi

subsections.title: 2.2 Assets Master
subsections.paragraph: Har asset ka record — AC unit, geyser, TV, kettle, lift, pump. Asset code, location, brand/model, purchase date, warranty, AMC details. Repair history isi pe attach hoti hai. Excel export bhi hai.

subsections.title: 3.1 Maintenance Master (HK Integration)
subsections.paragraph: Room-wise maintenance complaints ka register — Housekeeping ya FO complaint raise karte hain (room pe AC kharab hai etc.), technician status update karta hai (Pending → In Progress → Done). Room block/OOO bhi yahin manage hota hai.

subsections.title: 3.2 Service Master
subsections.paragraph: Service types define karo — Electrical, Plumbing, AC, Carpentry, IT. Complaint category isi se aati hai, department wise assignment ke liye.

subsections.title: 3.3 Complaint-to-Resolution Flow (Training Flow)
steps: Complaint aayi — HK/FO/Guest portal se (ya khud banao)
Maintenance Master me complaint register karo — location + service type
Material laga ho to requisition (Inventory module se)
Room tha to HK ko inform karo — room status update (cleaning ke liye)

rows: Room OOO/block manage karo FO ke saath
Complaint banao, room ko OOO/block mark karo agar repair lamba hai, FO ko batao alternate room dene ko
Gate Pass Exit (Inventory) + asset pe remark
Asset history dekho — replacement suggest karo
Service Desk / Service Request Register me accept karo
Asset list me nahi dikh raha
Room OOO status FO me nahi gaya
Maintenance se room block karo ya FO se manually
